messages:
Alex H.: heads up — acme reported sustained 429s and ~800ms tail latency on Dedicated yesterday during a sudden marketing spike. they say autoscale didn't kick fast enough. attaching timeline and repro below.

Maria T.: thanks. what's the dedicated config for that tenant? min/max replicas? any burst config?

Alex H.: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20, scale_policy=cpu_and_queue_delay, target_cpu=60, headroom=0.2. traffic jumped from 8 rps -> 52 rps in ~45s. logs show scale decision at +30s but new replicas healthy only at +160s.

Jon P.: that gap smells like instance warmup (model load + kvcache) rather than just scheduler delay. do we have per-replica warmup time metrics for that model (redwood-7b-v2-qat)?

Priya S.: looking at infra metrics now. model size ~14GB FP16, quantized, but we still load weights to GPU on start. average load-time we have recorded: 90-120s cold. plus container init ~15s. so ~130-150s expected.

Casey (oncall): that's consistent with what I saw. customer expected linear scale within 30s. our autoscaler picks desired replicas quickly but the heavy part is instance-level warmup. we should clarify headroom and burst capacity behavior to support teams.

Alex H.: customer is arguing this is "autoscaler not scaling" — they saw many 429s while waiting. repro steps I gave them:
1) set traffic generator to ramp 5 -> 52 rps over 45s
2) call /v1/generate with content-length ~1k ctx
3) observe 429s around +40-+120s, errors drop after +170s

Maria T.: can you paste the autoscaler decision logs and the pod events? need timestamps.

Alex H.: pasted below (sanitized):
```
[1779501240] autoscaler: desired=6 current=2 reason=queue_delay>threshold
[1779501252] kube: creating 4 new pods
[1779501300] pod/new-worker-1: Pulling image
[1779501365] pod/new-worker-1: Started container, loading model
[1779501450] model-load: 12.8GB loaded to GPU
[1779501510] pod/new-worker-1: Ready
[1779501520] autoscaler: current=6 desired=6
```

Jon P.: so decision at +8s, pods created ~12s later, ready at ~276s after root — matches the customer timeline. two contributing factors: model load time + image pulling (they're in us-west).

Priya S.: I also see intermittent 429s correlate to queue depth metric hitting hard during the warmup window. No OOMs in container logs. no noisy-neighbor CPU steal reported on the GPU node; GPU utilization initially 95% on warmup but that's load-time activity.

Alex H.: customer asked for mitigation. suggested options: increase min_replicas to 6 for expected bursts, enable reserved burst capacity (if eligible), or pre-warm with a lightweight probe to keep model resident. they pushed back on higher min due to cost.

Maria T.: can we offer a short-term workaround: automated prewarm on scheduled windows or a prefetch trigger when traffic delta > X? also check image pull optimizations — ensure our CDN/registry edge isn't a bottleneck.

Casey (oncall): we have a knob in Dedicated to keep model cached between requests (persistent-kv=true) but it still needs initial load after pod create. for immediate relief we can propose a transient canary: scale-to-min+(burst_target) before expected campaign windows. ops can do manual scale for now.

Jon P.: engineering follow-ups: 1) add a preflight warmup lifecycle hook that runs model-load early in init and reports progress to autoscaler; 2) capture model-load-time metric per pod into TSDB; 3) consider faster image distribution (layer caching, registry mirrors in region).

Priya S.: I'll open infra ticket for registry mirror and per-model load-time metric.

Alex H.: customer wants clear repro we ran + suggested mitigations. sending a support note proposing: prewarm endpoint + guideline to set min_replicas based on expected max concurrent requests and model load time.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3374 assigned to eng-runtime (link)

Maria T.: thanks team. I'll draft the customer message and include explicit numbers (expected warmup ~2.5 min for that model, recommended min_replicas=6 for their peak).

Casey (oncall): capturing action items:
- Priya: infra ticket for registry mirror + tsdb metric (ETA 1w)
- Jon: design warmup hook + autoscaler signal (ETA 2w)
- Alex/Maria: customer comms + short-term manual scale guide (ETA today)

Alex H.: leaving notes in the customer ticket with logs + repro. will follow up once infra ticket lands. :thumbsup:
